author: GXgamer
quote:
A great Resident Evil game that really brings together the best gameplay aspects of what resident evil has been during it's 30 years.
The characters are engaging with Grace and Leon perfectly balancing the horror-survival- action that Resident Evil games have adopted. 
Level design is great apart from the one late in the game.
You will love this game!

author: GXgamer
quote:
This is the first time I played Ocarina of Time. 
This is a love letter to the early times of gaming. It transports you to a more innocent time with mechanics that may seem more simple nowadays but really bring out the essence of what games were and should still be. 
It's a FUN game that is based in the classic but never dull hero's journey.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: GXgamer
quote:
Player 7-8 hours. It was my first GTA game. It's generally a boring game that misunderstands the simulation gameplay that it's supposed to aspire to. Realism to the extreme is not fun.This is not flight simulator. 
 Forced tedious chores that you get penaltied if you don't do. The main characters are either blunt or obnoxious.
It seems that the main Rockstar writer leaving left a big hole in the game.
